diagnosis.not_a_map_or_ranking_failure: The explicit R head and K ranking both pass, so the failure is localized after spatial UQ/relevance construction.
diagnosis.language_conditioning_failure: The decoder still prefers and generates the majority maintain wording when the on-path UQ counterfactual is supplied.
diagnosis.training_trace: On-path driving-answer NLL fell from 6.272017 at its first exposure to 0.202237 at its 24th exposure, but the matched maintain answer remained substantially more likely.
diagnosis.target_prior: Among the five driving-implication variants, three target maintain, one caution, and one prepare_to_yield. Plain token-average cross entropy does not explicitly require the expected answer to outrank the matched counterfactual answer.
diagnosis.interpretation: This is failure to overfit the intended conditional language distinction, not evidence of held-out overfitting or Stage2-L generalization.

required_before_any_new_smoke: Freeze a new objective amendment rather than extending epochs.
Use the same Route196 data, visual cache, seed, and fresh initialization.
Add an explicit matched-answer preference or balanced conditional objective.
Keep the existing zero/off-path, R-map, K-ranking, and generated-answer gates unchanged.
Record the new run as a different optimization experiment, not a continuation of v3.

claim_boundary: Route196 remains a one-event engineering learnability diagnostic. No VLM understanding, generalization, trajectory, closed-loop, or safety claim is supported.
